blocker: The 56 sheet archives have six layer-set variants. The profile proves geometry lineage from pee_ori_4 for spatial views, but does not establish one uniform result-table schema, a canonical cross-sheet key, view semantics, join cardinality, duplicate policy, or a selected product purpose. A transformation would guess those meanings.

allowed: verify all 56 archive checksums, ZIP integrity and profile checksum
enumerate each sheet's layers, fields, view SQL, row count and CRS
compare every variant against a proposed selected layer set
measure fid and candidate-key uniqueness and cross-sheet collisions
document view-to-pee_ori_4 lineage and join cardinality without creating output
forbidden: creating an analytical or production output

deterministicOutput.artifact: Canonical UTF-8 preflight JSON, sorted keys with newline termination, containing only measurements and source bindings.

intendedUse: Preparation for an owner decision; not an inventory transformation.
